capabilities: Capture ideas through a quick dialog with category and tags
Track idea statuses from New to Implemented and Archived
Search and filter ideas in a side panel
Export all ideas to a Markdown digest
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says it was developed within the author's OrbitKit suite with help from Claude.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for quickly capturing fleeting ideas and later tracking them through statuses until implemented or archived.
summary: Idea capture system that stores each idea as a note with category and status, offers a side panel with search and filters, and resurfaces random unfinished ideas.
